title: try 3 & Done — see your three things
excerpt: Say or type what's on your mind and watch it become the three things that matter — no signup, ~30 seconds.
content_html:
empty your head.

everything you've been meaning to do, one line at a time. messy is fine — when you're done, it chooses three and says why.

what you type stays here unless you sign up — it leaves only to be ranked —
and your voice never leaves this browser.
